description: Sign in to Microsoft Teams, inspect bounded chat history, and send only to an explicitly owner-approved chat.
configHelp: Guide setup with Configure with AI and the Teams Client view. Start with `codeterm plugin teams-client login`; complete Microsoft 365 work or school sign-in in the browser opened by the view. Keep any sign-in URL, device code, and credentials in the view; never ask the user to paste them into chat or include them in command output. Poll `codeterm plugin teams-client login-status`, then confirm with `codeterm plugin teams-client health`. The tenant may require a Microsoft 365 administrator to approve the m365 CLI app consent. The pinned m365 CLI installs into the plugin-owned runtime path when Node.js 20+ and npm are available. Do not use command-line config to move secret values through chat. This plugin enables `agent_commands`. Agent verbs include `accounts`, `use <account-id>`, `chats`, `history <chat-id> [n]`, `health`, `logout`, `login`, `login-status`, `preview <chat-id> <text>`, and `send <chat-id> [--key <idempotency-key>] <text>`. Refresh chats, choose an immutable chat id, inspect the preview including sender tenant and exact text, then explicitly approve that one chat in the view before sending is enabled. There is no default send policy. History is capped at 50 messages and 32 KiB.
